name: Screensaver pack
desc_cs: 14 spořičů (matrix, hvězdy, cluster, aurora, bounce, eq, grid, hypno, neon, retro, scan, vital, deep, dmg) + anti-burn drift. Každý je čistý JSON - uprav v našem editoru, externím editoru nebo s AI; katalog propů = props-export.json. Vlastní kousky sdílej zpátky s komunitou.
desc_en: 14 screensavers (matrix, stars, cluster, aurora, bounce, eq, grid, hypno, neon, retro, scan, vital, deep, dmg) + anti-burn drift. Each is plain JSON - tweak it in our editor, an external editor or with AI; prop catalog = props-export.json. Share your own back with the community.
